name: Cocoyam Fufu
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cut the cocoyam into medium-sized chunks, and cook in a pot of water until tender. Drain the cocoyam.
Combine the cassava flour with ½ cup water to make a mouldable ball.
Add the cassava mixture to the cooked cocoyam in a mortar. Pound together until smooth.

culture.text: Fufu is a pounded meal found in West African cuisine originally made from boiled cassava, plantains, and cocoyam. Fufu's prevalence in West Africa has been noted in local literature, such as Chinua Achebe's Things Fall Apart.
